Furthermore, the first stage FET is a luxurious FET specially made by Marantz that has low-noise characteristics and excellent thermal and electrical pair characteristics. In addition, the RIAA deviation, which indicates the accuracy of record reproduction, is ¥0.2 dB (20 Hz to 20 kHz) by carefully selecting an equalizer element with good characteristics and high accuracy.It has a built-in MC head amplifier, a DC configuration using a low-noise FET at the first stage, and an extremely low feedback impedance to improve the S/N ratio.While listening to FM music, you can record completely different sources on each of the two decks independently, from the Phono input on the A deck and from the AUX terminal on the B deck. This not only expands deck play, but also eliminates the hassle of pin plug connections when dubbing from deck to deck, and improves playability.For faithful disc playback, the impedance matching between the cartridge and the amplifier must be accurate. The SC-7 comes with a selector that can be easily adjusted to 5 levels of 1k � ~ 100k � for MM type and 4 levels of 10 � ~ 220 � for MC type.It is equipped with a tritone control for room equalization in any sound field. The tone amplifier is composed of DC-differential amplifier using FET Ï‰ full push-pull amplification Ï‰ SEPP. It is a BAX type with good control characteristics. In addition to the BASS TREBLE, it is equipped with the MID control for mid-range correction. The TURN-OVER switch switches the turnover frequencies from 2 kHz to 10 kHz for High and from 500 Hz to 100 Hz for Low. It is also equipped with a variety of functions from room acoustic to program correction. For example, tone correction can be added to the source during recording by linking with the TAPE EQ switch.The tone bypass switch allows the phono signal to be sent directly to the PRE-OUT without passing through the tone circuit with a single switch.A headphone amplifier of high sensitivity A class 0.5W design, volume control with low noise with 4-connection type volume adoption, gold finish input / output terminal which prevents sound quality degradation, etc. are substantial."

name: DV9500
description: "A universal player developed with cutting-edge image technology and Marantz's audio technology.It is equipped with HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface) which is an interface for digital audio-visual equipment. The HDMI connector can simultaneously transmit uncompressed digital video and digital audio signals such as Dolby Digital, DTS and Linear PCM.In combination with digital video equipment such as projectors equipped with this connector, full digital transmission and full digital processes are possible from the entrance to the exit.The I/P conversion and scaling part of the video processing circuit is equipped with a 10-bit digital processing circuit. By installing the latest high-precision 10-bit scaler, it is possible to upconvert 480P video signals to higher-definition 720P or 1080i signals via the HDMI terminal and output them.In progressive processing, 10-bit digital processing enables four times higher precision than general 8-bit processing. In addition, a newly developed algorithm reduces shaggy (stepped noise on diagonal lines) and produces sharp images.In addition, since the image adjustment is performed by the I/P conversion section, the image quality can be adjusted for digital output as well as analog output.The video encoder is equipped with a 216 MHz / 14-bit video encoder that oversamples interlaced signals by 16 times and progressive signals by 8 times, enabling high-precision D/A conversion and more natural contour reproduction.In addition, the 14-bit model has improved color reproducibility and luminance tone reproducibility compared to the 12-bit model. In addition, the Noise Shaped Video (NSV) technology shifts video noise components to unwanted bands, effectively removes noise with an analog filter, and suppresses signal degradation and aliasing noise, thereby improving the total video S/N ratio.Equipped with a video adjustment function, it is possible to perform real image quality adjustment such as DNR/CNR / detail / brightness / gamma / chroma delay which can be finely adjusted according to the projector and display.High-quality output circuits such as high-bandwidth video amplifiers and discrete filters are used.All 6-ch equal-quality audio output boards equipped with HDAM are mounted.In order to block the influence of the video circuit, it is separated from the video board and the whole back of the board is shielded. In addition, attention is paid to the wiring of the board and the arrangement of parts to improve the sound quality.The DAC is equipped with a total of three DAC CS4398 s made by Cirrus Logic, one each for front L/Rch, surround L/Rch, center ch & subwoofer, and one for each.There is also a separate DAC for headphones.Uses a newly developed DVD/Super Audio CD dedicated module.This mechanism is based on the one developed in S¥400, and the module with less noise radiation is realized by using one circuit board and four layers of glass epoxy board.In addition, the tray has a black paint that has an anti-vibration effect and is less affected by diffused laser reflection.In addition to the conventional double-layered chassis, the chassis strength of the main chassis top cover has been increased.Equipped with a video off mode that can turn off all video circuits after I/P conversion from the power supply / control system.Equipped with a dedicated transformer for audio circuit.Uses 0 impedance copper plate.Brass machined gold plated Analog output terminal is mounted.Equipped with DTS96/24 decoder enabling 5.1 ch playback at 96kHz/24bit.This is the world's first stand-alone DVD player equipped with a Dolby Headphone.Equipped with the Lip Sync function, when connected to a plasma display or projector, the time gap between video and audio caused by the processing time of the video circuit can be corrected up to 200 msec in 10 msec increments.Equipped with a sound mode function, you can directly select the playback area of Super Audio CD with the remote control, which had to be switched by showing the menu screen on the display in the previous model.It is equipped with delay time and bus management functions that can be adjusted during SACD playback in addition to DVD video and DVD audio.You can use the startup screen that displays a JPEG image when the power is turned on.Marantz original design is used for the GUI for initial setting.Equipped with RS232C control terminal for custom installation using controllers such as CRESTRON.Support for SACD multi-channel, DVD audio / video, video CD, SVCD, audio CD/CD-R/CD-RW, MP3 and JPEG.It has a built-in Dolby Digital / DTS decoder.Supports DVD-RW disc (video mode) playback.Equipped with PAL/NTSC conversion function.Equipped with PAL progressive playback function.Equipped with D2 video output terminal."

name: SA-11S1
description: "SACD player SACD player developed as a reference player.It uses a new premium design that completely replaces the conventional Marantz design.This design is based on the basic concept of expression by light which is not limited only by shape and arrangement. In addition to the front panel of solid aluminum 3 piece construction, aluminum side panel which firmly supports the inside is adopted.It is equipped with Marantz original PEC (Phase Error Compensation) circuit using 24 bitDSP, and realizes flat characteristics of phase delay.In addition, this DSP achieves 8 x oversampling and 1st order noise shaper.Equipped with a digital filter 3-mode switching function, both SACD and CD can switch the most suitable digital filter for the system to 3-mode. In addition, the DC filter and noise shaper can be turned ON/OFF during CD playback.For CD playback, Filter1 is a filter with an original slow roll-off feature that creates a performance image characteristic of analog records and a rich, smooth, deep sound field, while Filter2 is a filter with a slow roll-off feature that realistically reproduces the mid-low to mid-range range.Filter3 is a filter with standard sharp roll-off characteristics. This filter reproduces the coefficient of SAA7220PB, a digital filter with 4 times operation adopted in CD-94/CD-95/CD-95SE, and has 8 times operation. Compared with Filter1/2, the sound is sharp.ON/OFF of the noise shaper and DC filter can be selected for each of the three filters.The noise shaper is a digital feedback, but you can check the difference in the gloss of the sound by turning it ON/OFF. In general, turning it OFF reduces the measurement characteristics, but it expresses the gloss of the sound.The DC filter cuts out sound below 1.7 Hz. Turning the DC filter OFF provides a more natural sound field.During SACD playback, Filter1 is a direct mode that does not filter DSD data, so it faithfully reproduces the original source.Filter2 filters and attenuates the portion of DSD data exceeding 100 kHz. In addition, by making the operation in the DAC asymmetric, the resolution of the DAC is given priority and the multi-level can be operated at up to 40 multi-level.Filter3 filters and attenuates the portion of DSD data exceeding 100 kHz. The operation in the DAC is 23 multi-level, fully symmetric operation. This filter has the best characteristics when combined with the I/V conversion in the latter stage.The D/A conversion section is equipped with two SM5866AS DACs manufactured by NPC Corporation.This DAC performs 12 times of oversampling internally at the PCM input, and converts 96 times of the total signal, including 8 times of the input signal, into 23 levels by the third noise shaper function, greatly reducing residual quantization noise from the audio signal band to the high frequency band.It has a direct mode that does not pass the internal digital filter when the DSD signal is input, and a Route 3 that attenuates the quantization noise of the DSD in the digital domain through a FIR type digital filter and outputs the current with a 23-40 level DAC.In addition, there is an internal register, and the input data is always written in the word clock and system clock which are compared in phase, and it is accurately read out to be jitter-free.It is input to the HDAM construction of the triple stage configuration output from D/AC.The I/V conversion section is equipped with a discrete I/V conversion circuit composed of HDAM.By directly coupling the current output of the DAC with the HDAM, we aim to improve the small signal loss that does not appear in the physical characteristics.A discrete HDAM circuit is used for the LPF after I/V conversion, and a current feedback type HDAM circuit is used for the output circuit to achieve a low impedance and low noise.The output is not only unbalanced but also full balanced analog output using XLR terminal. It is composed of current feedback type HDAM circuit similar to audio output to ensure the same output impedance and performance as unbalanced output.The block capacitor used in the power supply section is a custom Marantz product developed through repeated trial manufacture and trial listening. The power transformer is a super-ring toroidal transformer with OFC winding. The case is filled with a high-density material to prevent the vibration of the transformer from affecting sound quality.We use high-quality audio parts such as Schottky barrier diodes and mica capacitors for the rectifying circuit of the audio power supply.It is equipped with a digital output whose data is crystal relocked by the master clock.In addition, the SA-11S1 automatically stops the digital output in order to eliminate the effect on SACD playback. In addition, the digital output can be turned off during CD playback.Uses brass block machined gold-plated analog terminal.A mechanism module developed in-house by Marantz is used for the mechanism part.A stabilizer is mounted on the upper surface of the mechanism to increase rigidity.A ¥5 ppm high-precision type crystal is placed near the DAC to supply the optimum clock to the DAC with high precision.System remote control is included."

name: CD-25
description: "This is a Philips Marantz CD player with a sound quality design similar to the high-end model.Equipped with a 4 x oversampling Z filter.The Z-Filter, which consists of a digital filter that oversamples the sampling frequency (44.1 khz) to 176.4 khz, four times the sampling frequency, and a third order Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics, ensures excellent phase characteristics. description: "A high-performance CD player based on technologies such as a 4 x oversampling digital filter and a left-right independent 2D/A converter.While maintaining the basic configuration of the ""Z-Filter"", which is composed of a 4 x over-sampling digital filter and a 3rd order Bessel filter, the D/A converter is equipped with a 16-bit 4 x over-sampling LSI instead of the conventional LSI in order to improve performance.We have also introduced newly developed LSIs for digital filters and PLL demodulation circuits before D/A conversion, so that the decoder circuit can be integrated into a 3-chip LSI.The CD drive uses a newly improved CDM-2 that is compact, lightweight, and vibration-free.The sub-chassis, swing arm, and other CD drive mechanical components are made of high-density glass-wool plastic, which is used in medical and precision equipment. This reduces weight and reduces resonance frequency.In addition, using Philips' proprietary replica technology, the surface of the objective lens is coated with a 10-micron nonspherical film, and the optical system consists of two lenses, eliminating spherical aberration that cannot be avoided with spherical lenses.In addition, the focusing mechanism has been improved from the conventional MM (moving magnet) type to MC (moving coil) type to enable quick tracking.The CDM-2 is mounted in a completely floating structure, and the tray lid, which was integrated with the tray, is also separated, and the entire CD drive mechanism including the tray is separated from the chassis and floats.Equipped with a digital output.Remote control (RMC-75) with 10 keys is included.Equipped with a multi-display that centrally displays three types of time information : total time, elapsed time, and remaining time, track amber, and index number.When combined with a Marantz / Synchro / Rec compatible cassette deck (SD565, SD-74, etc.), you can control the recording start with the play button of the CD-75.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.With the direct play function, when you press the play button, the disc tray closes and play starts automatically.Features include a random access program of up to 20 songs, skip play of up to 99 songs, index play, 3-speed search and repeat function."

name: CD-80
description: "This CD player was created by introducing the latest devices such as S1 type D/A converter and CDM-1MkII mechanism.The D/A converter uses the S1 type TDA1541A-S1 with a crown mark, which is carefully selected from the latest A version. The CD-80 uses a 16-bit 4 x over-sampling digital filter to convert the signal into an analog signal using an L/R-independent S1 device. This eliminates harmful digital components such as 0 cross distortion.The mechanism section is equipped with a CDM-1MkII mechanism that employs a robust die-cast frame and a long-life brushless Hall motor. In addition, the entire mechanism is made completely floating with dampers and springs to achieve excellent loading performance.In addition, unlike normal linear tracking, it uses a swing arm system with weights placed at the rear, making it possible to read signals stably at all times.Access time is further improved by adopting newly developed servo ICs for the servo circuit.The main chassis is solid die-cast, the top is non-magnetic aluminum plate and the bottom is 3-mm-thick metal plate. In addition, the circuit parts are strictly selected, including specially made ones, and the copper thickness of the signal path is doubled where necessary to improve sound quality.Since a DC coupling configuration is adopted in the output stage and no capacitor is required to cut off the DC component, there is no signal degradation.It is equipped with a unique FTS function that can program 126 discs semi-permanently (as a program of 5 songs per disc).It is equipped with functions such as a 20-track program, five edit functions, random play, and AMS (Automatic Music Scan) that plays songs sequentially.It has a dimmer function that can adjust the brightness of the display.In addition to fixed and variable analog outputs, it is equipped with optical and coaxial digital outputs.Equipped with a 35-key full remote control. Dimmer and AMS are remote-only functions.Available in 2 color variations, gold and black."

name: CD-84
description: "In order to improve sound quality, stability, and operability, a CD player was developed by developing original technology and investing a number of know-how and technologies.Equipped with a Z filter that is an improved and developed digital filter.The Z-filter consists of a digital filter, a D/A converter and a low-pass filter. The Z-filter oversamples the sampling frequency by a factor of four, so that 44.1 kHz becomes 176.4 kHz, which is processed by a low-pass filter with gentle characteristics. This eliminates the deterioration of phase characteristics and transient response characteristics caused by the high-order filter.The low-pass filter of the Z filter uses a Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics in addition to the low order of 3rd order. It ensures good phase characteristics up to high frequencies, and at the same time, expands the pass band to 30 kHz to improve transient response characteristics.In addition, a left-right independent 2D/A converter is used for D/A conversion to prevent phase rotation.Swing arm pickup is used for the pickup part.The swing-arm pickup has a structure with a laser pickup at the tip and a counterweight at the rear to achieve a dynamic balance, enabling a stable pickup trace at all times.The world's smallest semiconductor laser pickup is used in the pickup section.Through miniaturization, the components of the pickup have been simplified, and the optical system components have been reduced to two lenses and one beam splitter, thereby maintaining high assembly accuracy and improving reliability.In addition, the miniaturization of the entire pickup makes it possible to achieve a high-efficiency design that effectively uses only the central portion of the laser beam.A unique swing arm pickup is mounted on an aluminum die-cast base to suppress external vibration and microvibration of the rotating system and improve stability.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer and a large-capacity capacitor. In addition, the power supply for circuits that generate switching noise, such as audio circuits, digital circuits, servo circuits, and digital displays, is separated, and a completely independent power supply is used to suppress noise.For each stage, we use parts that have been learned through hearing.In addition, the earth point, an important factor in determining sound quality, also determines the best focus by hearing.It is equipped with a random access program and a delete program for up to 24 songs, an auto music scan for playing only the intro, a head-start function, a skip function, a back-stop function, a repeat function, and a music standby function.Equipped with a large display capable of displaying digital display + program indicator.Equipped with digital interface terminal.It can be operated from a remote location by the attached dedicated remote controller.It is also compatible with the Marantz Bus System that carries out remote control and easy operation using a dedicated microcomputer. Remote control is possible by using the audio timer AT333R together with the remote control transmitter RMC-10."

description: "Special edition CD player developed based on CD-95Various changes have been made such as the adoption of toroidal transformer.The CD-drive mechanism uses CDM-1, which was developed by Phillips-Marantz Group.By mounting a one beam swing arm pickup on a die-cast base and controlling the swing arm with a servo system, which is completely different from the three beam linear tracking system, a smooth and reliable bit trace is achieved.The D/A conversion circuit consists of an original LSI ""TDA1541AS-1"" developed by Phillips-Marantz Group.It uses a carefully selected microchip from the A version of Philips' latest device at the time, and guarantees accuracy of 0.5 LSB for small signal and 1 LSB for normal level over the whole temperature range.We have also adopted a push-pull D/A conversion method using two D/A converters per channel, which successfully eliminates harmful components that cause sound quality degradation.The power supply section has an independent transformer dedicated to the FL display, and other parts are completely separated by supplying them with a toroidal transformer. name: CD650
description: "CD player with 16 bit 4 x over-sampling digital filter and CD filing bank FTS.Equipped with a unique Z-filter centered around a 4 x oversampling digital filter and a left-right independent 2D/A converter.In the CD650, a newly developed 16-bit 4 x over-sampling LSI is incorporated into this Z-filter. By operating at 176.4 kHz, this Z-filter achieves excellent phase characteristics inherent in the 4 x over-sampling system and high transient response characteristics with a pass band of 30 kHz. In addition, a third order Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics is used as the low-pass filter after D/A conversion.The D/A converter employs a 2-DCAC system with dedicated D/A converters on the left and right sides, reducing the occurrence of phase shift. In addition to two D/A converters contained in a single chip LSI, newly developed LSIs for a digital filter and a PLL demodulation circuit are introduced, and stability is enhanced by integrating a decoder circuit into three chips.The mechanism uses CDM-2, which is an improved version of our original swing arm mechanism, and the floating structure reduces the influence of vibration and resonance.While inheriting the basic design of the swing arm 1-beam laser pickup, the CDM-2 is a completely new material and optical system. The CD is determined by a unique ID code. The ID code combines the TOC data recorded on all CDs and can be automatically input simultaneously with the program.The memory of FTS can be up to 155 songs, assuming that five songs are programmed on one CD. The memory element is EEPROM (2 kbyte), and the program can be either track, time or index and can be programmed up to 20 songs on one CD.It is equipped with a multi-display which displays the operation of each function such as FTS, track, index, elapsed time and remaining time in a centralized manner.It is equipped with a random access program of up to 20 songs, skip play, scan function, 5-mode repeat, auto pause, copy pause to insert a 4-second blank between songs, and 3-speed search.Equipped with a headphone port equipped with volume.There was a side wood as an option.It comes with a remote control that allows you to control most functions including random access from your hand."

name: MODEL1120
description: "A pre-main amplifier designed to simplify the circuit and achieve a high-quality balance.All stages of the power amplifier section are directly connected with a differential amplifier circuit on the top.A perfect pair is created for the two stones of the differential amplifier stage, and these two stones are coupled into one to keep the same state thermally, and excellent characteristics are obtained in one stage.A diode is used for each part to achieve perfect temperature compensation, and a special air-core coil is used to prevent degradation of the distortion factor in the high-frequency. Thus, careful phase compensation is performed.The power transistor is a special product jointly developed by Marantz and Motorola.The protection circuit is the same type as the Model 500. If there is a leakage current to the speaker, the relay operates and turns OFF. In addition, the timing is shifted by the relay until the amplifier is fully operational in order to prevent the click sound caused by the instantaneous rush current when the switch is turned ON as well as muting.The power transistor is a current sensor type that controls the current of the complimentary service stage.And in case of overheating, the thermostat of the heat sinker is set to operate.The pre-section equalizer stage has a two stage configuration, with a differential-amplifier circuit at the top and a SEPP pure complimentary service circuit at the final stage.In addition, the feedback loop is completely directly connected, and two stages of negative feedback are applied.A capacitor of 1.0 Ï‰ F is inserted at the top of the differential circuit to cut off unnecessary high frequency components, and a resistor of 22M � is inserted to completely remove the click at the time of equalizer switching.The tone circuit is also a two stage direct-coupled type. It has a configuration with a differential amplifier circuit on the head and the last stage is held down by a � balance power supply. It goes up and down with selectivity in the negative feedback circuit. Normally, the two stages take the feedback of one stage and keep the input impedance large and the output impedance small.CR type is adopted for both low and high filter stages.The power supply for the preamplifier is a constant voltage power supply that also serves as a complete ripple filter for both the + and - sides.Almost all parts are put together on a total of six printed circuit boards, and all switches and rotary switches are printed circuit boards. In addition, there is no shield wire that is normally routed from the input terminal to the selector switch except for one location. This is a fundamental solution to the problem of noise caused by wiring, which is a problem in high-end machines.Instead of the usual wire wrapping method, a wire clamp is used to fix the lead wire. This structure allows each circuit board to be adjusted independently even later.For printed circuit boards, copper foils are coated to prevent corrosion and breakage.Switches are designed so that they can be switched at the place where they are really needed by lengthening the shaft, and the shortest connection is realized.The back side of the input terminal board is completely shielded with copper foil to prevent induction noise from the outside. In addition, a special contact relay made in Austria is used to prevent contamination with dust and eliminate contact.In addition, there is a space in the center of the inside that can hold 4 fist to avoid mutual interference.Equipped with a scope out terminal that can monitor the phase characteristics of the cartridge.Walnut cabinet and rack mount adapter were sold separately as an option."

description: "Low TIM design DC configuration pre-main amplifier.It is equipped with an MC head amplifier that realizes a high gain of 26 dB by adopting the newly developed super low noise high gain FET 2SK130A.The audio FET 2SK130A has characteristics equivalent to about five FETs of the type used in the conventional MC amplifier, and various characteristics such as frequency characteristics, distortion factor, S/N have been greatly improved.The power amplifier circuit uses a DC-configuration OCL-inverted Darlington circuit connected to all stages to produce an output of 65W per ch.Moreover, a FET cascode bootstrap circuit is adopted in the first stage of the power section to solve the problem of drift. When the power level is exceeded (from 30W to 120W for PM-6a), the operation is automatically switched to class AB.The switching is done purely electronically using a high-speed switching circuit newly developed by Marantz.The power amplifier section equipped with this QuaterA system is fully push-pull DC configuration with built-in DC-servo circuit, and excellent characteristics are obtained by the Low-TIM design that reduces transient distortion by improving bare characteristics and reducing NFB of the amplifier.Dedicated to the MC cartridge, it is equipped with a genuine headphone amplifier with 13 transistors per channel from the 4-parallel push-pull input stage with ultra-low noise transistors to the SEPP configuration output stage.The phono amplifier section uses Marantz's unique push-pull circuit configuration for all stages to achieve high SN and high dynamic range. In addition, the equalizer element uses a metal-coated resistor with an error of 1% and a polypropylene capacitor with an error of 2% to achieve excellent characteristics.Equipped with a TONE switch that can bypass the entire tone amplifier circuit.In the Tone Out position, the output of the flat amplifier is directly connected to the power amplifier, so you can enjoy a purer quality.The power supply section is equipped with a small large-capacity power transformer with improved heat resistance by filling with special resin, and a super audio condenser of 22,000 Ï‰ Fx2 that is carefully selected for sound quality.In addition, a heat pipe system with high heat radiation effect is adopted, and stable operation is obtained even in pure A class which consumes a large current.It is equipped with two phono inputs, of which Phono1 is equipped with 27k ¥, 47k � and 100k � MM load clock in addition to the MC head amplifier position.In addition, it is equipped with functions such as a tape copy switch that allows two decks to dub each other, two levels of loudness, and independent tone control on both sides.There was a mahogany cabinet sold separately."

name: PM-8
description: "A DC pre-main amplifier that pursues a low-TIM design not only for the power amplifier but also for the control amplifier.A 3-stage direct SEPP output type is used for the equalizer stage. In addition, it has excellent low-noise characteristics, and Marantz special order FET with almost perfect matching of pair characteristics in thermal and electrical characteristics is used to obtain excellent SN ratio.Also, the equalizer element is carefully selected to have good characteristics, and the RIAA characteristic is ¥0.2 dB.The BAX tone amplifier is equipped with not only Bass/Treble but also Mid control for more precise sound field correction. In addition, the variable range can be changed with the Turn-Over switch.Tone correction is also available for the source during recording in conjunction with the TapeEQ switch.Newly developed Super Hi-f in the main amplifier sectionTTransistor is used.This transistor is an element developed by combining LSI process technology and high-frequency power transistor technology. It has excellent high-frequency and switching characteristics, and has sufficient amplification performance up to an ultra-wide range.A power transformer is installed for pre-power and power respectively.In particular, a large power transformer is used, an independent power source system on the left and right sides is adopted, and a 15,000 Ï‰ Fx4 large-capacity capacitor of Hi-Fi design is adopted.Equipped with 2-system record selector.For example, while listening to FM, you can record completely different sources on each of the two decks, such as Phono input on the A deck and Aux on the B deck.Equipped with a cartridge load selector, it is possible to match the impedance of the cartridge with that of the amplifier.For the PM-8, the input impedance can be selected from five levels for the MM type and four levels for the MC type.Equipped with MC head amplifier.Marantz's original energy sensor protection circuit is mounted.Comes with a wood cabinet."

name: PM-8MKII
description: "Based on the PM-8, this pre-main amplifier has been further polished to a higher level of perfection.In order to reduce transient intermodulation distortion, we have developed our own Low-TIM design for the control section as well as the power section.In addition, in order to eliminate noise degradation at high output in class AB, newly developed super high-ft transistors with an ft of 90 MHz are used for all four single-channel and parallel push-pull connected power transistors, thereby reducing switching distortion.A DC configuration MC head amplifier using a low-noise FET with matching pair characteristics is mounted on a DC configuration equalizer with a 3-stage direct connection SEPP output stage.Equipped with a cartridge load selector, it is possible to draw out the performance of the cartridge more.It is equipped with a tritone control that can be adjusted in each of the low, middle and high ranges. In addition, the sound field can be adjusted more finely by changing the turnover frequencies between the low and high ranges.The two decks are equipped with two types of record selectors that can record different sources independently.You can also add tone correction during recording.The power transformer is equipped with a pre-power transformer and a power transformer, respectively. In addition, the output transformer and the capacitor are custom-made with large capacity and high reliability and are independently configured on the left and right to prevent the deterioration of regulation.Coaxial cable is used for the shield wire portion of the signal system that handles low voltage, and oxygen-free copper wire is used for all other lead wires.The protection circuit includes a unique energy sensor type that protects the power transistor without interrupting music playback."

name: PM-11S1
description: "A pre-main amplifier developed over 2 years as an integrated amplifier inheriting the concept of a separate amplifier.This item uses a new premium design that is different from the previous Marantz design.This design is based on the basic concept of expression by light which is not limited only by shape and arrangement, and uses the front panel of solid aluminum 3 piece construction and the aluminum side panel which firmly supports the inside.A low-noise LCD is used for the display, and the front panel controls are illuminated in blue.By reducing the impedance of the signal line with the linear control volume and HDAM SA2, and by reviewing the internal layout, channel separation at high frequencies has been improved by more than 10 dB.This improves not only channel separation between the left and right channels, but also channel separation between different amplifier stages.The power supply section and power block section are designed to be extremely low impedance. The instantaneous current supply capability has been improved by more than two times by using a substrate with a foil thickness of 70 microns, OFC extra-thick wiring material for the high-current section, high-speed power transistors and Schottky barrier diodes, and minimizing by reviewing the internal layout.It is equipped with HDAM SA2 which is an evolution of HDAM SA installed in SC-7S1/MA-9S1.The HDAM SA2 is a key module for voltage / current conversion of a current feedback amplifier. It is also suitable as a high-speed buffer amplifier. It is also a compact module because of the need to reduce the circuit area for high channel separation.The PM-11S1 is equipped with a current feedback phono amplifier, balance buffer amplifier, line buffer amplifier, volume amplifier, voltage amplifier, and power buffer amplifier that are composed of many HDAM SA2s.It follows the design concept of the SC-7S1 and is equipped with a dedicated input amplifier for all inputs.It is equipped with a current feedback type balance buffer amplifier using HDAM SA2 for the balance input, and is compatible with devices with a balance output.All line input terminals are equipped with line buffers using dedicated HDAM SA2 to prevent interference between each input source.The linear control volume developed in the SC-7S1 is used for the volume.This volume can be adjusted linearly between 0 and -100dB with an accuracy of ¥0.5 dB.The phono equalizer amplifier is equipped with a current feedback circuit for the first time as a Marantz.Both MM and MC cartridges are supported.The power amplifier section follows the design concept of the MA-9S1, and consists of two amplifiers of 11 dB voltage amplifier (voltage amplifier circuit) and 12.5 dB power buffer amplifier (power amplifier circuit).This prevents the back electromotive force from a speaker with a strong magnetic circuit from being fed back to the voltage amplification stage.A choke input power supply is used for the power supply for the input amplifier and the preamplifier, which handle small signals.This power supply consists of a high-capacity capacitor (15,000 Ï‰ Fx2) combined with a Marantz original hybrid transformer with a choke coil set in the ring core, and completely eliminates harmonic noise generated in the rectifier circuit and high-frequency noise from the outside.The power supply section employs a large super-ring toroidal transformer with a shield case with a built-in choke coil, a low-foil magnification low-impedance capacitor (18,000 Ï‰ Fx2), and a Schottky barrier diode to support a power buffer with an instantaneous current supply capacity of approximately 50A.Equipped with F. C. B. S (Floating Control Bus System).This function synchronizes up to four PM-11S1s through high-speed bi-directional communication. It supports complete bi-amplifier and multi-channel.System remote control is included."

name: PM-14
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that has been developed by gathering the know-how of amplifier production that has been cultivated up to now such as SC-5, PM-16, PM-17, etc.The power amplifier section uses the latest Marantz current feedback type.In this method, phase compensation is reduced by lowering the feedback impedance, and an extremely high-speed amplifier can be realized. In addition, the amplifier is stable against load fluctuations, and the output choke coil, which is harmful to sound quality, can be removed. This is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The first stage is voltage-amplified by a high-speed adjustable HDAM, followed by an I/V converter using a current mirror circuit after impedance conversion, and connected to a 3-stage Darlington power amplifier that can obtain a DC amplification factor. The output stage is single-push-pull with a Pc = 200W multi-emitter bipolar transistor.A 100% DC feedback is applied to the first stage, and by adjusting the DC offset of the adjustable HDAM, the DC servo due to active elements, which is a problem in S/N, etc., can be eliminated.The power transistor is mounted on a large heat sink with sufficient space through a copper cover that serves as both vibration isolation and shielding.The preamp section uses Marantz's original 4-channel active volume system.In this method, a volume is also inserted into the NF circuit of the preamplifier and linked with the input volume to continuously change the gain of the preamplifier. Since the residual noise of the amplifier is mainly generated at the first stage, the residual noise can be reduced by changing the total gain. On the PM-14, the preamplifier section has a full gain of 20 dB, but the gain can be reduced by about 14 dB, which improves the S/N ratio.The circuit configuration uses a low-noise, high-slew rate adjustable HDAM, and the output section is equipped with a bipolar transistor diamond SEPP buffer to sufficiently reduce the output impedance. The preamplifier section can also be used independently.The volume uses a die-cast housing for the motor clutch, and the shaft uses a Duque product made of brass, which is superior in sound quality.The tone control amplifier uses an active filter type that uses a Bar Brown high-speed OP amplifier.With this method, even when the low and high frequencies are raised, the rise of unwanted frequencies (ultra-low and ultra-high frequencies), which is harmful to the speaker, is suppressed, and there is no waviness in the frequency response in the flat position.It is equipped with an NF-type phono equalizer amplifier for each MC/MM cartridge.The first stage uses the latest adjustable HDAM (high-speed voltage amplification module) with low-noise FET, and the output uses a high-gain, high-slew rate audio OP amplifier to ensure low output impedance and sufficient gain for the MC input.The power supply uses a 450 VA super-ring core toroidal transformer with high efficiency and low magnetic flux leakage. In addition, it is equipped with two large stress-free low-double foil filter capacitors with no sleeve.In addition, Marantz's unique noise-killer element is inserted between the windings of each rectifier circuit to absorb high-frequency noise during rectification.Equipped with a balanced input for CD.For the balanced input, impedance conversion is performed with a voltage follower using a Bar Brown high-speed OP amplifier, and then accurate mixing is performed up to high frequencies using the same OP amplifier. As a result, in-phase components such as external noise are canceled over a wide band, taking advantage of balanced transmission.The interior is based on a solid and highly accurate copper-plated high-density zinc die-cast chassis. On top of this chassis, the layout takes into account sufficient separation of left and right channels, small signal and large signal areas, rational signal flow and efficient power supply.A logic relay system is used to provide optimum layout for switching between input and REC output.The relay uses a highly reliable sealed type for the communication industry.All unbalanced input terminals are gold-plated, especially for the CD input terminals, which use wide pitch machined terminals.There are two sets of speaker terminals made by WBT (Germany). These terminals can be used with Y-lugs or banana plugs. They can also be used with thick cables for reliable mounting. In addition, they are designed so that there is no difference in sound quality. This makes it possible to use two sets of speakers or connect by wire.Pre-in pre-out and power-in terminals allow the use of a pre-amplifier and a power amplifier independently. In integrated use, the pre-amplifier and power amplifier are designed to be connected as quickly as possible by means of a changeover switch.Also, in consideration of the use of active subwoofer, the pre-out is designed to be output even when integrated.System remote control is included."

name: PM-14SA
description: "A pre-main amplifier based on the PM-14 for Super Audio (next-generation digital audio).The basic configuration is based on the PM-14. It uses a strong and high precision copper plated and high density zinc die-cast chassis with a phono equalizer amplifier, balance buffer amplifier, preamp, tone control amplifier, power amplifier and power supply mounted on top of it. The layout remains unchanged.In addition to the current feedback type used in the power amplifier of the PM-14SA, we have also adopted a newly designed current feedback type in the preamplifier section. By realizing a preamplifier with high drive capability with low noise and high slew rate, we aim to ensure high speed and dynamic range of unit amplifiers for next-generation digital audio.As for the circuit configuration, a voltage amplification module with adjustable HDAM with DC offset adjustment is adopted at the first stage. Impedance conversion is performed by the FET buffer, and current feedback is injected into it. This realizes high S/N ratio and low output impedance.The power amplifier section uses a current feedback type and reduces the feedback impedance to reduce the phase compensation and realize a high-speed amplifier. This method ensures stability against load fluctuations while eliminating the choke coil in the output section, which affects sound quality, and is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The circuit configuration is connected from the first stage where the adjustable HDAM amplifies the voltage, to the power amplifier of the 3-stage Darlington which obtains the DC amplification factor through the I/V conversion part using the current mirror circuit after the impedance conversion. The output stage is a single push-pull type with a multi-emitter bipolar transistor of Pc = 200W. In this circuit, 100% DC feedback is applied to the first stage and the DC offset adjustment of the adjustable HDAM is carried out to eliminate the DC servo by the active element which causes a problem in S/N, etc. by adjusting the DC offset of the adjustable HDAM.The power transistor is set on a large heat sink via a copper cover for vibration isolation / shielding.The power supply uses a 450 VA super-ring core toroidal transformer with high efficiency and low magnetic flux leakage. In addition, it is equipped with two large stress-free low-double foil filter capacitors with no sleeve.A unique noise killer element is inserted between the windings of each rectifier circuit to absorb high-frequency noise during rectification.Equipped with an NF-type phono equalizer amplifier for MC/MM cartridges.The first stage uses the latest adjustable HDAM (high-speed voltage amplifier module) with low-noise FET, and the output uses a high-gain, high-slew rate audio OP amplifier.In the balanced buffer amplifier, the impedance is converted by the voltage follower of the OP amplifier, and then mixed by the same OP amplifier to cancel in-phase components such as external noise over a wide band, taking advantage of balanced transmission.A logic relay system is used for switching between input and recording output.The relay uses a highly reliable sealed type for the communication industry.All unbalanced input terminals are gold-plated. Especially for CD input terminals, wide-pitch machined terminals are used for high-grade cables.The speaker terminal is made by WBT of Germany, and it is compatible with banana plug, Y lug and thick cable.Equipped with an input / output terminal and a selector switch for independent use of a preamplifier and power amplifier.In consideration of the use of active woofer, the pre-out terminal is designed to be in the output state even when integrated.Wireless remote control is included."

name: PM-14SAVER2
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier with improved perfection by applying the technology obtained in the SC-7S1/MA-9S1 to the PM-14SA.The power supply circuit has been extensively revised.The electrolytic capacitor of the power supply block uses a low-foil magnification / low-loss cobalt capacitor of the same series as the one used in the separate amplifier. The power transformer uses a 450 VA super-ring-core toroidal transformer with high efficiency and low leakage flux. In addition, the power supply line is made as short as possible, and the ground potential is completely reviewed to eliminate potential fluctuations.The Schottky barrier diode, which was also used in the separate amplifier, is fully adopted in each rectifier circuit to achieve high efficiency and low noise.The preamplifier uses the current feedback circuit that is also used in the PM-14SA. It also uses the high-precision low-noise metal-coated resistor and polypropylene film capacitor used in the separate amplifier to achieve low noise and high slew rate.The first stage employs an adjustable HDAM voltage amplification module that can adjust the DC offset. The FET buffer is used for impedance conversion and power feedback is injected into it. The second stage uses a SEPP + diamond output circuit with bipolar transistors to provide a high-speed, high-current amplification factor and a power amp-like configuration to ensure sufficient drive capability.A conventional current feedback circuit is also used for the power amplifier, and the film capacitor and resistor used in the separate amplifier are used. By reducing the feedback impedance, phase compensation can be made lighter and a high-speed amplifier is realized. This circuit is stable against load fluctuations and can remove the choke coil in the output section, which is harmful to sound quality. This circuit is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The circuit is connected from the first stage, where the voltage is amplified by a high-speed adjustable HDAM, to the power amplifier of a 3-stage Darlington, where the DC amplification factor is obtained through an I/V converter using a current mirror circuit after impedance conversion. The output stage is a single-push-pull configuration with a Pc = 200W multi-emitter bipolar transistor.By applying 100% DC feedback to the first stage and adjusting the offset of the adjustable HDAM, it is possible to eliminate DC servo due to active element which is a problem in S/N, etc.The power transistor is set on the heat sink via a copper cover with high vibration isolation / shielding effect.The CD input terminal uses a wide pitch shaved terminal.The speaker terminal is made by WBT of Germany.Equipped with an input / output terminal and a selector switch for independent use of the preamplifier and power amplifier.In consideration of the use of active woofer, the pre-out is designed to be output even when integrated.In addition, by setting the gain of the power amplifier section to the same value as that of SM-17SA ver. 2, the possibility of bi-amplifier connection is obtained.Uses a copper plated high density zinc die-cast chassis.Equipped with a phono equalizer amplifier.Uses solid aluminum insulator.Conductor cross-sectional area 2 mm2The OFC power cable is included.Wireless remote control is included."

name: PM-15
description: "Pre-main amplifier developed as the highest peak of the PM series.Since the PM-80, two types of output systems, Class A and Class AB, have been integrated into Class AB, and a newly developed power block called Super AB class is adopted.A high-frequency bipolar transistor (Pc = 200 pc = W) in parallel push-pull mode to ensure high current drive capability.The pre-part and power part are completely independent of each other in the layout to eliminate electrical interference.In addition, a balanced method is adopted for the connection between the two devices to minimize the adverse effect of external noise on the music signal.The 4-row active volume used in the volume section employs a low-impedance, rotating resistor volume that is particularly excellent as a volume component.The phono equalizer uses a full-scale low-noise amplifier configuration such as a head amplifier of a push-pull differential circuit.The circuit board is a double-sided foil printed circuit board with a thickness of 70 Ï‰ m. This improves shield performance and ensures drive capability for low-impedance speakers.Uses HDAM, a unit unique to Marantz.This uses a copper case and a multi-layer substrate shield structure to suppress the effects of heat, vibration, and electromagnetic waves and provide stable performance.As a result, in addition to the low-noise high-through rate, space efficiency and high stability, which are the advantages of ICs, are realized.As a countermeasure against high-frequency noise, an extra-large copper plated toroidal power transformer is plated with copper and a low-foil electrolytic capacitor is used to ensure a stable power supply.In addition, noise killer elements are installed in the power, pre, and control sections to suppress rectification noise and realize sound without turbidity.The chassis is based on a copper-plated zinc die-cast chassis and consists of a 3-mm-thick steel plate top panel, extruded aluminum front panel and legs carved out of pure copper blocks to eliminate vibration completely.All input / output terminals are gold-plated, and the same large crimping type speaker terminal as the one used in the PM-99SE is used."

description: "This is a pre-main amplifier equipped with Marantz digital support technology and designed for high sound quality with Quarter A and AVSS.A Quarter A circuit has been developed and installed on the PM-84 in order to achieve both high output, which does not clip even at high level, and quality at low output, which reproduces low level.This Quarter A operates in pure A class with excellent linearity for low level up to 1/4 (quarter) of maximum output, and moves to AB class at higher level to realize high power.Each operation achieves a smooth shift by controlling the bias current with a high-speed switch circuit.Equipped with an AVSS (Auto Voltage Shift Supply) that shifts the output supply voltage according to the power. In addition to the copper chassis, 2/3 of the screws used are copper screws. This structure emphasizes sound quality.The side wood was sold separately."

name: PM-84D
description: "Based on the PM-84, this pre-main amplifier was developed in pursuit of higher quality reproduction sound in order to realize 100% of CD capability.The PM-84D has a MOS FET at the output stage.The MOS FET has excellent switching characteristics, distortion characteristics, and thermal characteristics, making it ideal for use as a power amplifier. Non-magnetic materials are actively used for parts that may be affected by eddy currents such as chassis and screws, and copper-plated chassis and copper-plated screws are used.In addition, more than 100 parts are examined through hearing to improve sound quality."

name: PM-94
description: "Pre-main amplifier with Marantz's separate amplifier technology.The output stage is a triple push-pull configuration using MOS FET.MOS FET has characteristics such as ""excellent high-frequency characteristics, high withstand voltage and high power can be applied at the same time"", ""because it operates only with majority carriers in principle, high input impedance higher than that of J-FET is realized"", and ""because there is little accumulation effect during switching, turn-off time is extremely shortened and high-speed switching is possible"". Together with Marantz's original Quarter A, MOS FET realizes ideal operation.Using a unique Quarter A circuit, it performs full class A operation up to 1/4 of the maximum output and automatically shifts to class AB operation up to the maximum output. This autoshift is controlled by an electronic control. It detects the output voltage of the main amplifier and controls the bias current with a high-speed switching circuit.The detection speed of the PM-94 circuit is higher than that of the conventional Quarter A circuit, enabling smoother control.In order to fully demonstrate the performance of the MC cartridge, two high performance MC transformers are mounted on the MC input independently on the left and right sides.This transformer has a 2-coil configuration and uses double shielding in the core direction and winding direction. It has a quality close to that of the high-sound MC transformer ""MC1000"".The step-up ratio is switchable between High and Low.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer and a 90,000 Ï‰ F large electrolytic capacitor.In particular, toroidal transformers are shielded by three layers of silicon steel plates to prevent flux.Copper-plated steel sheet material ""Copper-Tight"" is used throughout the chassis, and the uniform copper-plated finish of Copper-Tight is more effective than conventional copper plating.Thorough tuning has been applied, such as using parts that have been examined through hearing.We have adopted a pair electrolytic capacitor with equivalent characteristics and sound quality, and switches with improved sound quality by copper-plating. In addition, 70-micron thick circuit boards and oxygen-free copper wires are used.In addition, in order to eliminate the change in sound quality caused by soldering, the condenser is fixed with screws and all screws are copper plated screws.Equipped with a CD direct position. In this position, the input selector is directly connected to the flat amplifier by jumping to a stage such as an input selector or a tape monitor. Moreover, since the flat amplifier is an FET input, the change in input impedance is almost negligible even when the resistance of the master volume itself changes.Equipped with HiFiVCR monitor position, you can enjoy music playback by HiFiVCR with the same feeling as a tape monitor."

name: RV-55
description: "Digital sound field controller that realizes digital delay by introducing digital technology cultivated in CD development.This is the first time that a digital delay has been used exclusively for audio. The technology accumulated through the development of CDs has been fully utilized. The A/D and D/A converters are equipped with devices equivalent to CD players.In addition, a 5-band graphic equalizer and a sub-channel power amplifier are incorporated.In digital delay, a delay signal and a reverberation signal are extracted and blended into a direct sound to restore a sense of presence. In the RV-55, an analog signal is digitized to extract a delay signal. The A/D and D/A converters use the same 16-bit A/D and D/A converters as CD player devices, providing a high signal-to-noise ratio and a wide dynamic range.The digitized signal is stored in the ring buffer sequentially and is read out with a specified time difference. The memory capacity which determines the accuracy is 64 kbit.A microcomputer is used to calculate the delay time, and any delay time (0 ~ 99 ms) can be freely set. A one chip microcomputer (8-bit) is also used to control signals such as RAM.The reverb circuit incorporates a dedicated feedback circuit that returns the delayed signal to the input, adds it back to the input, and then returns it to the input of the reverse channel to reproduce the second and third order reflections and the continuously generated reverb components.In addition, the reverb circuit can shift the delay time setting between channels within a range of ¥15 ms. It can also be used to correct acoustic characteristics when the sound condition of the listening room differs greatly from left to right.The delay time can be preset, and can be set in increments of 1 ms with the up/down switch.The set optimum value can be stored up to 3 points and can be recalled with one touch by the switch.A matrix circuit is installed in the input section to control the difference signal between the left and right channels. It is possible to add a surround effect without damaging the sound image located at the center.Equipped with video input / output terminal.It has a built-in power amplifier for the sub speaker.Equipped with a 5-band graphic equalizer.It is equipped with a master volume that can control the volume of the main system and subsystem simultaneously.A sub-dedicated volume is also installed to adjust the volume balance of the subsystem.Tape dubbing circuit is mounted."

name: RV450PRO
description: "Surround processor with Dolby Pro Logic Decoder.The Dolby Pro-Logic Surround System is a home-use surround system that reproduces the same effect as a movie theater by installing almost the same circuitry as the professional surround decoder developed by the Dolby Research Institute for movie theaters in order to clarify sound localization and realistic sensation.In the Dolby surround sound recording, the front L/R component and the surround component that surrounds the person are recorded in a composite state, and the surround effect is realized by separating and playing back this component.The RV450PRO is equipped with a directional enhancement circuit that improves the front-rear and left-right channel separation from the conventional 3 dB to more than 25 dB. In addition, the 3-channel L, R, and S (surround) playback is replaced with 4-channel L, R, C (center) and S playback to separate the sound image at the center and localizing it.The surround channel is equipped with a digital delay circuit that outputs a signal 20 msec behind the front channel. This greatly reduces noise compared with the conventional analog method and makes sound localization clearer. The surround channel S/N ratio of 96 dB is achieved by using a noise reduction system in this circuit.Equipped with three modes that can be freely selected according to the type and size of the speaker used for the center channel.The normal mode is most suitable for the case where a small speaker is used for the center channel rather than the left and right speakers. The center speaker outputs a signal of 100 Hz or higher, and the signal of 100 Hz or lower, which has little influence on the direction localization, is distributed to the left and right channels.Wide mode is used when the center channel speaker is equipped with a bookshelf type or higher speaker that can fully reproduce overtones. The output separated by the directional enhancement circuit is sent directly to the center channel.Phantom mode is a mode in which no speaker is used for the center channel. The center channel signal is divided equally into left and right by the directional enhancement circuit.In addition to the Dolby Pro Logic Surround mode, Hall Surround and Matrix Surround modes are also built-in.Hall surround gives the sound as if you are listening in a hall, while matrix surround mode cancels out the signal located in the center of the left and right and emphasizes the indirect sound, so that you can play back more realistically, such as a during sport joint.With a built-in test tone generation circuit, the test tone automatically circulates through each channel of L, R, C and S, and the level can be set according to the listening condition.Equipped with a master level controller that can simultaneously control the volume of four channels : L, R, C, and S.It is also equipped with center volume and surround volume that can adjust center output and surround output."

name: SD-64
description: "A cassette deck equipped with various functions and a noise reduction system to support digital audio.Equipped with Oatley bath function by infrared photo sensor and rotary head.The infrared photo sensor detects the difference in reflectivity between the magnetic part of the tape and the leader part, and the rotary head immediately rotates to perform reverse operation.The rotary head can record and play back both ways with the same head, so there is no difference in sound quality, and azimuth adjustment is possible in both directions.The mechanism is equipped with 2K byte dedicated microcomputer + 3 motors (1 motor for capstan, 1 motor for reel, and 1 motor for head movement) for reliable and stable operation.A large flywheel is used to obtain smooth rotation.Dynamically stable back tension is maintained by the newly developed tension mechanism dynamic stability tension system using new material Rulon.It is equipped with a double dummy head in order to eliminate the dispersion of travel performance in round trip, which is a problem in reverse deck.Both sides of the rotary head are equipped with dummy heads to maintain accurate tape position and achieve stable tape travel.The audio circuit has a DC configuration with only two coupling capacitors from input to output. The head-connected DC configuration improves the phase characteristics.In addition, the audio system, the logic circuit for each display control, and the power circuit are separated from each other to improve sound quality by reducing the influence.The noise reduction system is equipped with Dolby B/C and dbx.Equipped with a sync recording function, you can control the recording start with the player start of the playback device by combining it with a device with a sync recording terminal (such as CD-84).It is equipped with a blank search function that finds the beginning of an unrecorded portion of a recorded tape, checks the playback until about three minutes ahead, returns to the beginning of the unrecorded portion, and performs recording standby (REC/PAUSE).It is equipped with a quick rewind function. If you press the rewind switch after recording, it returns to the position where the recording started and automatically goes into play standby (play / pause).It is equipped with an Auto Rec Mute function that makes a 4-second non-recording part with one touch and automatically records on standby.Equipped with a QMS (Quick Music Sensor) function that allows you to skip 20 songs before and after.It is equipped with an index scan function that plays the head part of each song for 10 seconds.Equipped with a memory function, the position of the tape can be memorized by operating the memory switch, and stop or play at that position.You can repeat one song by pressing the play switch twice.It is equipped with a volume that can control output output and headphone output.It is equipped with a large display including a peak hold level meter and 4-way digital counter.It is equipped with a Marantz bus system and can be remotely controlled when connected to a model equipped with a balance bus system."

name: SD-66SE
description: "This is an improved special edition cassette deck based on SD-66.Many improvements such as toroidal transformer have been made.Various technologies have been put into the mechanism to ensure the ideal tape running.A die-cast head base with integrated parts that control the running and a fly wheel made of high-precision high-weight ceramic. A closed-loop dual capstan system that realizes stable tape head touch. A cassette half stabilizer that effectively eliminates microvibration and modulation distortion of the cassette half realizes stable tape running performance.The head part is equipped with a recording / re-combination head, and the core material uses high hardness permalloy with excellent magnetic characteristics.In addition, the head coil is made of PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper material) to minimize signal loss and provide optimal gap settings for recording and playback.The recording and playback amplifiers are independent from each other to achieve a low noise level.The recording amplifier uses a constant current drive system that can supply the required current without being affected by the inductive impedance of the recording head.The first stage of the regenerative amplifier uses a low-noise FET in a differential configuration, reflecting the know-how of phono amplifier circuits cultivated in high-grade amplifiers and realizing an improved S/N ratio.Equipped with the Dolby HX PRO, which works only during recording and improves high-frequency characteristics, and Dolby B/C with MPX filter.The power supply section employs a toroidal transformer to solve problems such as leakage flux and vibration of the tape running mechanism.It is equipped with a powerful noise killer circuit to deal with rectification noise, which has a large effect on sound quality even by a very small amount, and absorbs high-frequency noise generated during rectification.The body uses a copper-plated chassis to prevent high frequencies from jumping into other elements.In addition, by adopting a 3 mm thick vibration-proof top cover, vibration from the outside is reduced due to its weight, and it becomes a double vibration-proof countermeasure.It uses a large display equipped with functions such as a linear tape counter that can switch the elapsed time from a normal tape counter, a mode character display that displays operation status with characters such as digital characters, and a digital peak level indicator with a 5-second peak level display and a MAX peak level memory function.It is equipped with a QMS (Quick Music Sensor) that starts out the songs you want to listen to, an AMS (Automatic Music Scan) that plays the intro of each song for about 10 seconds one after another, and a blank skip function that detects unrecorded parts during playback and automatically fast-forwards.An auto tape selector that automatically identifies metal, chrome, and normal tape types, a REC calibration that corrects the recording sensitivity of the tape to make the best use of the tape characteristics, a cassette in indicator that notifies the standby of the cassette tape by turning on, and an anti-rec indicator that turns on when the tab for preventing the erasure of the tape is broken.The input / output terminals are equipped with a line input Route 3 and two line outputs (one Fixedx and one Variablex), all of which are gold-plated."

name: SD-74
description: "A 3-head reverse deck equipped with Dolby B/C and dbx.The head part uses a combination type 3-head system.In the 3-head system, the optimum gap width is set for both the reproducing head and the recording head to improve the high-frequency characteristics during reproduction and the recording capability during recording. In addition, hard permalloy with excellent magnetic properties is used for the head material to improve MOL.The reverse mechanism uses a rotary system that rotates the head mount.The rotary type has the advantage that the same head can be used for both directions, and the azimuth can be adjusted in both directions, making it easy to achieve uniform characteristics.The reverse position is detected by an infrared photo-sensor system, in which the sensor senses the difference in reflectivity and issues a command for the start of reverse rotation at the moment when the magnetic material disappears and enters the reader tape.An erasing head is installed on both sides of the rotary type combination head to keep the position of the tape accurately.The mechanism section focuses on the accuracy of metal parts, and the total accuracy is improved by thoroughly eliminating distortion during molding.In addition, the flywheel is 1.7 times heavier than the conventional one, reducing sound quality degradation caused by the traveling system.The drive system is a 3-motor double flywheel system.In addition, the SD-74 uses a new back tension mechanism called the Dynamic Stability Tension System, which uses a new material, Rulon, to provide dynamically stable tension.It also has a mechanism that automatically prevents tape from sagging.A 2Kbyte dedicated microcomputer is used for the drive system of the mechanism to improve the certainty, speed and stability of operation.By separating the audio circuit from other circuits, the effect on sound quality is reduced.The audio circuit consists of a DC configuration with only two coupling capacitors. In addition, direct connection from input to output is promoted so that both recording and playback are directly connected to the head.We have also introduced the latest constant-current drive IC for the recording amplifier, and the amplifier driven by a constant current improves the high-frequency saturation level during recording.In addition to the Dolby B and Dolby C type noise reduction systems, it is also compatible with the dbx system.All NR systems can be monitored, so the Dolby B/C is a double circuit.The display section is equipped with a level meter with a peak hold function and a 4-digit digital counter.In addition to the normal tape counter, the digital counter is equipped with functions such as displaying the remaining time of the tape, the elapsed time (wrap type), and displaying the number of songs when the music is selected (when the QMS switch is ON).Features include blank skip, index scan, memory stop / play, repeat (two play button press), blank search, quick rewind, auto-rec mute and timer standby.Synchronized recording is possible by combining with CD-84 etc.Equipped with an output level adjustment volume.It is compatible with the Marantz bus system, and remote control and easy operation are possible by connecting with a machine compatible with the same system."

name: SD930
description: "This is a stereo cassette deck with high sound quality using MAAC, Compu-Bias, and dbx technology.It is equipped with MAAC (Marantz Auto Azimuth Control) which is a unique azimuth automatic adjustment function.The MAAC consists of a specially developed 4-slit head and IC, an actuator drive with piezo (piezoelectric ceramic element), and a MAAC phase indicator that displays the amount of azimuth error in real time, enabling accurate error detection and instantaneous response azimuth correction at the world's fastest speed of 3/100 seconds.The 1-chip MAAC-specific IC was originally developed to process the four signals reproduced by the MAAC head, and achieves high reliability by performing phase comparison, pulse conversion, and data processing within the 1-chip IC.It is equipped with a Compu-Bias system that allows the computer to automatically set the optimum bias, level and equalizer settings. The microcomputer controls the bias, level and equalizer (2 points of 7 kHz and 15 kHz) for each channel in 32 steps in approximately 10 seconds.
